Maya Chen: Hi all — orientation invite is showing at 02:00 local time for me (Singapore). Welcome email said 9am PT. Also there's no join link in the event. Is that right?
Aisha - People Ops: Welcome Maya! Canonical time is 9:00 AM PT (that's 00:00 SGT next day normally). We record every session and post the video + a short recap in #new-hires. Which email did you accept with?
Maya Chen: I accepted with my personal email (maya.chen.personal@gmail.com) — haven't got my company account yet.
Eli - IT: That will do it. Meet links attach for internal accounts only by default. I just re-shared the invite from onboarding@redwood.com to maya.chen.personal@gmail.com and forced conferencing links to attach. Refresh your calendar in a minute.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Redwood New Hire Orientation" — Zoom + Meet attached. Recording enabled. Slides will be uploaded 45 minutes prior.
Maya Chen: I can see the Zoom link now, thank you. One more question: will slides be available before the session? I like to skim.
Aisha - People Ops: Yes — slides go into the event and the onboarding Drive folder ~45m before start. We also post a 10-minute highlight clip for APAC folks who can't join live. DM me if you want the raw recording earlier.
Maya Chen: Great, thanks everyone!
